evals.prompt: Review this endpoint: `GET /users/:id` authenticates the caller, then returns the requested user record without checking ownership. Explain the issue, attack path, smallest correction, and negative test.
evals.expected_output: Identify broken object-level authorization, explain ID substitution, enforce same-user-or-authorized-role server-side, return 403, and test cross-user access.

evals.prompt: Review a server endpoint that fetches an arbitrary user-provided HTTPS URL and follows redirects. Provide the smallest safe SSRF correction and tests.
evals.expected_output: Use a destination allowlist, resolve and reject private/link-local/loopback/metadata addresses, revalidate redirects, bound time and size, and test DNS/redirect bypasses.

evals.prompt: The user requests a full repository security audit. Choose the appropriate workflow and explain why a short OWASP checklist is insufficient.
evals.expected_output: Route to the codebase security audit skill and its layered secrets, SAST, SCA, taint/data-flow, semantic/CPG, IaC, custom-rule, and DAST workflow.
